filter_note.note: Hand pass kept 81 club-room items (dropped MLB/NBA/NHL/NASCAR/college bleed, Swiftie/celebrity, power-rank/league parks, merch/gags, nostalgia, near-dups). Quiet is correct for HOU.

items.title: Cardinals Place Rookie Safety Kitan Crawford on IR with Ankle Sprain
items.one_line: Arizona moved seventh-rounder Kitan Crawford to IR with a mid-ankle sprain from the Week 1 win over the Chargers; designated to return after at least four weeks, with Kalen King promoted and Jerrick Reed II / Art Green added.

items.title: Seahawks Slight Favorites Over Cardinals Despite ESPN Model Edge
items.one_line: Both 1-0 clubs meet Sunday in Glendale with Drew Lock starting for injured Sam Darnold; lines favor Seattle by ~3.5–4.5 while ESPN's model gives Arizona a 53.7% win chance.

items.title: Falcons Fans Roast QB Mess Ahead of Panthers Game
items.one_line: Kevin Stefanski has yet to name a starter for Sunday vs. Carolina with Penix (ACL), Tagovailoa (oblique), Rush (Week 1 picks), and undrafted Jack Strand in the mix; fans venting with memes and trade ideas.

items.title: Falcons Place Hand on IR, Promote Muse and Add Practice Squad Depth
items.one_line: Atlanta put DT Da'Shawn Hand on IR with a season-ending torn quad from Week 1, promoted TE Nick Muse, and added RB Khalil Herbert plus edge Drake Jackson to the practice squad.

items.title: Falcons QB Drama Builds Ahead of Panthers Home Opener
items.one_line: Penix split first-team reps with Rush (back spasms) while Tua sat with an oblique; Penix says he's 'dying to be out there' but holds himself to strict readiness benchmarks.

items.title: Ravens Place Rookie WR Ja'Kobi Lane on IR After Wrist Surgery
items.one_line: Third-rounder Ja'Kobi Lane went on IR after wrist surgery from the Colts win; best-case return ~Week 6, with Flowers day-to-day (hamstring), Gage Larvadain signed, and Jake Moody released.

items.title: Lamar Jackson and Declan Doyle Share Play-Calling Joy After Ravens Rout Colts
items.one_line: In Doyle's first game calling plays, Baltimore piled up 506 yards in a 41-23 win; Jackson threw for 324 and a TD plus a rushing score, Henry added 144 and three TDs.

items.title: Rashod Bateman Praised for Team-First Effort in Ravens Win
items.one_line: Bateman played a team-high 53 snaps with one target and zero catches; Minter and Jackson praised his blocking/routes, and his role could grow with Flowers and Lane hurt.

items.title: Bills Release Final Injury Report Before Lions Game
items.one_line: Cole Bishop, Ty Johnson, and T.J. Sanders are questionable after limited walkthroughs; Terrel Bernard is fully cleared after a calf issue ahead of Thursday's Highmark Stadium debut.

items.title: Bills Debut New Highmark Stadium vs Lions in Primetime Opener
items.one_line: Buffalo hosts Detroit at 8:15 p.m. ET on Prime Video for the first regular-season game at new Highmark Stadium; both teams are 1-0, with Lions missing starting OL pieces.

items.title: Bills Omit O.J. Simpson from New Stadium Wall of Fame
items.one_line: The Bills left O.J. Simpson off the new Highmark 'Family Circle' honors citing fit concerns despite his franchise rushing records; a petition seeks restoration while his HOF bust stays on display.

items.title: Panthers Waive Jimmy Horn Jr. After Costly Punt Muff in Opener
items.one_line: Carolina waived sixth-rounder Jimmy Horn Jr. a day after his muffed punt in the 59-37 loss to Chicago, signing LB Tyrel Dodson from the practice squad; Canales said they still value Horn.

items.title: Bryce Young's Strong Week 1 Performance Sparks Analyst Debate Before Falcons Rematch
items.one_line: Young went 23-of-37 for 361 yards and three TDs plus a rushing score in the loss to Chicago; Dan Orlovsky called him 'AWESOME,' drawing pushback from Bears fans ahead of Atlanta.

items.title: Caleb Williams Earns FedEx Award After Bears' Record 59-Point Opener
items.one_line: Williams (269 pass yards, 2 pass TDs, 65 rush, 2 rush TDs) won FedEx Air & Ground; D'Andre Swift (124, 3 TDs) took NFC Offensive Player of the Week as Chicago preps for Minnesota.

items.title: Bears Coach Ben Johnson Shuts Down Overconfidence After 59-Point Opener
items.one_line: After 59 points and 552 yards vs. Carolina, Johnson said 'We haven't put up any points this week,' stressing a fresh week for Brian Flores' Vikings defense at Soldier Field.

items.title: D'Andre Swift Earns Double Honors After Bears' Record Opener
items.one_line: Swift took NFC Offensive Player of the Week and Nickelodeon NVP after 124 yards and three TDs; he had just signed a three-year, $33.75M extension with $27.5M guaranteed.

items.title: Joe Burrow Expects to Play Despite Back Tightness After Bengals Win
items.one_line: Burrow was limited Wednesday with back tightness from a late-first-half hit in the 33-27 win over Tampa; he says if he's not getting surgery he'll be out there Sunday vs. Houston.

items.title: Bengals Vow to Feed Ja'Marr Chase More After Quiet Week 1
items.one_line: Chase had just two catches for 12 yards on four targets; OC Dan Pitcher and Zac Taylor owned the limited touches and vowed a bigger role vs. the Texans.

items.title: Browns Routed 34-10 by Jaguars in 2026 Opener, Watson Draws Heat
items.one_line: Watson went 16-of-22 for 205 yards, a TD, a pick, and five sacks in the loss; Monken defended sticking with him for Week 2 vs. Baker Mayfield's Buccaneers.

items.title: Baker Mayfield Faces Old Browns Team in Tampa Bay Rematch
items.one_line: Buccaneers host Cleveland in a matchup loaded with Mayfield history; Browns coach Todd Monken, his former OC, praised Mayfield's intelligence and competitiveness.

items.title: Rookie Jaishawn Barham to Start at Middle Linebacker for Cowboys vs. Commanders
items.one_line: Third-rounder Jaishawn Barham starts at MLB with the green dot after DeMarvion Overshown's injury; Schottenheimer praised his communication after six tackles in his debut.

items.title: Commanders and Cowboys Release Injury Reports Before NFC East Clash
items.one_line: Dallas sat Malik Hooker (forearm) and Overshown (hamstring); Washington listed Frankie Luvu (groin) and Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) as DNP ahead of Sunday's 4:25 p.m. ET FOX game.

items.title: Giants Stun Cowboys 28-20 as Skattebo's 'Let Me Eat' Steals Show
items.one_line: New York upset Dallas 28-20 on SNF (25.7M viewers); Cam Skattebo rushed for 81 and a TD, Jaxson Dart threw three scores in John Harbaugh's debut win.

items.title: Colin Cowherd Says Bo Nix Is in Trouble After Broncos' Blowout Loss to Chiefs
items.one_line: After Nix's 17-of-28, 131 yards, TD, INT, four sacks, and a fumble in a 31-10 loss, Cowherd said the QB is 'in trouble'; fans blamed a 45.5% pressure rate and penalties.

items.title: Bo Nix's Short Passes Spark Memes After Broncos' Chiefs Loss
items.one_line: Nix's average depth of target was just 3.86 yards in the MNF rout; PFF still ranked Denver's OL No. 1, fueling skepticism ahead of Jacksonville at home.

items.title: Chiefs Dominate Broncos 31-10 in Monday Night Rout
items.one_line: Kenneth Walker III powered KC's ground game and Mahomes added three total TDs; Denver mustered 176 yards and Sean Payton called it a poor showing across the board.

items.title: Bills Debut New Highmark Stadium vs Lions in Primetime Opener
items.one_line: Detroit visits Buffalo Thursday at 8:15 p.m. ET on Prime for Highmark's first regular-season game; Lions are without LG Christian Mahogany, RT Blake Miller, and C Cade Mays (IR).

items.title: Lions Face Offensive Line Woes Ahead of Bills Clash
items.one_line: Blake Miller (knee) and Christian Mahogany (hip) are out; D.J. Reed is questionable (foot) and Juice Scruggs limited (knee) on a short week for Thursday Night Football.

items.title: Packers' Aaron Banks Returns to Practice with Knee Sleeve Before Jets Game
items.one_line: LG Aaron Banks (knee tendinitis) returned Wednesday after missing the Vikings opener where Love took heavy hits; LaFleur said status vs. Jets is a game-time decision.

items.title: Packers Host Tryouts for Six Players After Week 1 Loss
items.one_line: Green Bay tried out DTs Zxavian Harris and Jalen Hunt, WRs Nick Nash, Bryce Oliver, Quincy Skinner, and DE Cruz Smith after the line struggled in the Vikings collapse.

items.title: Packers Face Jets Amid Fallout from Vikings Collapse
items.one_line: Green Bay blew a late lead as Minnesota scored 29 straight; critics hit LaFleur's fourth-and-1 decision and OL protection as the Packers head to MetLife on Sept. 20.

items.title: Colts Switch Green Dot to Linebacker After Week 1 Communication Woes
items.one_line: Indianapolis is moving the green-dot radio from safety Cam Bynum to LB Akeem Davis-Gaither after Week 1 communication breakdowns ahead of SNF at Arrowhead.

items.title: Colts Fans Push Back on Steichen's Wake-Up Call After Ravens Loss
items.one_line: After a 41-23 home loss allowing 506 yards, Steichen called it a wake-up call; fans cited last year's late collapse and questioned the phrasing entering Chiefs week.

items.title: Colts Face Chiefs in Primetime After Week 1 Wake-Up Call
items.one_line: 0-1 Colts travel to Kansas City for Sunday Night Football (8:20 p.m. ET) with Daniel Jones opposite Patrick Mahomes; KC listed as ~6.5-point favorites.

items.title: Jaguars Sign Ex-Cardinals Edge Rusher BJ Ojulari to Practice Squad
items.one_line: Jacksonville signed BJ Ojulari (four rookie sacks in 2023) after placing DE B.J. Green II on IR with an elbow injury from the Browns win; Jack Kiser elevated to the 53.

items.title: Nick Wright Crowns Trevor Lawrence Top of Mahomes Mountain as 'Prince Who Was Promised'
items.one_line: Wright put Lawrence atop his QB pyramid after a 9-0 stretch with 28 TDs and a 111.5 rating, including four TDs in the 34-10 Week 1 rout of Cleveland.

items.title: Broncos Fan Brandon Perna Picks Jaguars to Upset Denver
items.one_line: NFL Network's Brandon Perna picked Jacksonville over his Broncos for Week 2, citing Denver's ugly 0-1 start; Jags are live underdogs despite Denver's ~2.5-point favoritism.

items.title: Chiefs Dominate Broncos 31-10 in Record-Setting MNF Opener
items.one_line: Kansas City's 31-10 win drew 23.2M viewers (most-watched Week 1 MNF on ESPN); Mahomes rushed for a TD in his knee return while Kenneth Walker III shone in his KC debut.

items.title: Chiefs Rookie Delane Returns to Practice After Shoulder Scare
items.one_line: No. 6 pick Mansoor Delane fully practiced Wednesday after a Week 1 shoulder tweak; Reid said scans were negative and there's a good chance he plays Sunday vs. the Colts.

items.title: Tyreek Hill Reunion Buzz Builds for Chiefs This Season
items.one_line: Jeremy Fowler reports free-agent Hill remains fond of Kansas City and a midseason signing makes sense around an October return target after last year's knee injury.

items.title: Raiders' Brock Bowers Sits Out Wednesday Practice with Knee Injury
items.one_line: Bowers (meniscus trim preseason) sat Wednesday with hopes of returning vs. Chargers or by Week 4; Kubiak also held CB Darien Porter as Michael Mayer steps up at TE.

items.title: Raiders QB Kirk Cousins Jokes About In-N-Out Burger Addiction
items.one_line: After a 27-13 Week 1 win over Miami, Cousins said In-N-Out across from the stadium is his post-win cheat meal since moving from Atlanta—two Double-Doubles, no shake.

items.title: Chargers Sign Veteran MVS to Practice Squad After WR Injuries
items.one_line: LA added Marquez Valdes-Scantling after injuries to Ladd McConkey, Derius Davis, and KeAndre Lambert-Smith; the 6-4 veteran could be elevated for Week 2 vs. the Raiders.

items.title: Chargers Fans Debate Herbert's High Sack Total After Week 1 Loss
items.one_line: Herbert took three sacks in a 26-14 loss to Arizona (17-of-27, 209, TD, INT); fans blame blitz recognition, OL, and franchise mismanagement ahead of the Raiders.

items.title: Harbaugh Backs Herbert After Chargers' Season-Opening Loss
items.one_line: Jim Harbaugh said 'Love Justin. The sky's the limit' after the Cardinals loss, stressing building around Herbert, Derwin James, and Khalil Mack.

items.title: Aaron Donald Eyes Monday Night Debut Against Giants
items.one_line: Donald sat Australia Week 1 while ramping up; Rapoport says a very realistic chance he suits up Monday at SoFi vs. the 1-0 Giants, with Myles Garrett out (knee surgery).

items.title: Rams Unveil Classic Sol Uniforms Honoring 1951 Champions
items.one_line: Gold/yellow jerseys with blue satin numbers debut Monday Night vs. the Giants at SoFi, tying into the franchise's 75th anniversary and first L.A. title team.

items.title: Dolphins Edge Rusher Chop Robinson Limited by Concussion Protocol
items.one_line: Chop Robinson was limited Wednesday in Napa in concussion protocol ahead of the 49ers; he played 42 snaps in the Raiders loss and has prior concussion history.

items.title: Vikings Monitor Kyler Murray's Concussion Status for Bears Game
items.one_line: Murray practiced limited Wednesday in phase three of concussion protocol after the Packers win; O'Connell says medical clearance by Friday for a shot to start at Soldier Field.

items.title: Vikings Place Jordan Mason on Short-Term Injured Reserve After Thumb Fracture
items.one_line: Mason (59 yards, TD in Week 1) had surgery on a thumb fracture and is eligible as early as Week 7; DeeJay Dallas elevated, Jerome Ford added to the practice squad.

items.title: Vikings Blitz Past Packers in 39-22 Comeback Win
items.one_line: Minnesota blitzed on 82.1% of plays—highest single-week rate in a decade—sacking Love four times and hitting him 15 more in a 29-unanswered-point comeback.

items.title: Patriots RB Henderson Full Participant in Practice, On Track for Steelers Game
items.one_line: TreVeyon Henderson fully practiced Wednesday after missing Week 1 with an ankle injury; Crownover (knee) and Carlton Davis III (neck) did not practice.

items.title: Patriots Assign Gronkowski's No. 87 to New Receiver Romeo Doubs
items.one_line: New England gave Doubs (four-year, $68M from Green Bay) Gronk's No. 87; Gronkowski said he's fine with it since only Brady's 12 deserves retirement.

items.title: Ex-Jets Lineman Draws Heat for Comparing Team Cultures to Patriots
items.one_line: Alijah Vera-Tucker, now on a $42M Patriots deal, contrasted Jets numbness to losing with New England's win-or-nothing mentality, drawing sharp Jets-fan backlash.

items.title: Tyler Shough's Record Second-Half Rally Falls Short in Saints' OT Loss
items.one_line: Shough threw for 410 yards and three TDs (325 after half, a Saints record) in a 31-30 OT loss to Detroit; fans praised his arm talent ahead of the Ravens.

items.title: Ravens Face Lengthy Injury List as Saints Get Good News Before Week 2 Clash
items.one_line: Alvin Kamara returned to full practice (knee) and is expected to play; Ravens listed six DNPs including Zay Flowers (hamstring) and Trey Hendrickson (finger).

items.title: Chris Olave Tops NFL Receiving Yards After Week 1 Explosion
items.one_line: Olave leads the league with 182 yards on 10 catches from the OT loss to Detroit, ahead of Flowers, Christian Watson, Jalen Coker, and Dalton Kincaid.

items.title: Giants Stun Cowboys 28-20 as Skattebo's 'Let Me Eat' Steals Show
items.one_line: Cam Skattebo rushed for 81 and a TD with viral mic'd-up energy; Jaxson Dart threw three scores as John Harbaugh won his Giants debut on SNF (25.7M viewers).

items.title: Isaiah Likely Shines in Giants Debut with Two TDs vs. Cowboys
items.one_line: Former Ravens TE Isaiah Likely caught all eight targets for 78 yards and two TDs, helping New York control the clock in the 28-20 upset of Dallas.

items.title: Giants RB Cam Skattebo's Truck Chaos Steals Show Before Cowboys Game
items.one_line: Skattebo leaned out of his lifted pickup stuck outside MetLife yelling 'Let me in! I'm the running back!'—another viral moment after his Week 1 star turn.

items.title: Jets Bolster Roster with Shepard Signing After Week 1 Injuries
items.one_line: New York signed Sterling Shepard to the practice squad after Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle, week-to-week) and Minkah Fitzpatrick (groin, 2–3 weeks); Jordan Clark elevated.

items.title: Jets Debut Sleek White Helmets at Practice Before Home Opener
items.one_line: White 'White Out' alternate helmets debuted at Wednesday practice ahead of Sunday vs. Green Bay at MetLife; team urging fans to wear white.

items.title: Garrett Wilson Thanks Jets Fans Ahead of Home Opener
items.one_line: Wilson praised the fanbase's patience through tough years and expects big energy for the Packers home opener as New York enters 1-0 after beating Tennessee.

items.title: Eagles Place Landon Dickerson on Injured Reserve After Rough Opener
items.one_line: Three-time Pro Bowl G Landon Dickerson (bone bruise, right knee) is out at least four games; Drew Kendall steps up at LG after Dickerson called himself a liability on WIP.

items.title: Jalen Hurts Wins Sixth Straight Season Opener in Eagles' 24-22 Victory Over Commanders
items.one_line: Hurts threw for 203 yards and three TDs plus 46 rush yards; Philly used pre-snap motion on 62% of plays under new OC Sean Mannion before Week 2 at Tennessee.

items.title: Tariq Woolen Shuts Down Receivers in Eagles Debut Win
items.one_line: Woolen played all 70 defensive snaps in his Philly debut, allowing zero catches on four targets while shadowing Washington receivers including Terry McLaurin.

items.title: Rodgers Gifts Game Ball to Pittsburgh Native McCarthy After Steelers Win
items.one_line: Aaron Rodgers handed Mike McCarthy the game ball after the 20-13 win over Atlanta, saying 'First win for Pittsburgher Mike McCarthy' in rare locker-room footage.

items.title: Steelers Update Joey Porter Jr. Injury to Conditioning Ahead of Patriots Game
items.one_line: Porter Jr.'s status shifted from back injury to non-injury conditioning; he was limited Wednesday and sat Week 1 to ensure readiness for New England.

items.title: Seahawks Rule Out Darnold for Cardinals Game, Lock Starts
items.one_line: Sam Darnold is out Sunday with a glute soft-tissue injury; Drew Lock starts after going 16-of-22 for 187 yards and a TD in relief vs. New England.

items.title: Seahawks Slight Underdogs vs Cardinals in Week 2 Clash
items.one_line: ESPN analytics give Arizona a 53.7% win chance at home; Macdonald confirmed Lock starts at 4:25 p.m. ET on FOX after Darnold's Week 1 injury.

items.title: Seahawks Pro Bowler Fredd Young Passes Away at 64
items.one_line: Former Seahawks LB/special-teamer Fredd Young (four Pro Bowls, 1984–87) died at 64; Seattle and New Mexico State remembered his tackles, sacks, and family life.

items.title: 49ers Hit by More Injuries After Week 1 Win
items.one_line: Rookie De'Zhaun Stribling had ankle surgery (~10 weeks); TE Jake Tonges is done for the year (torn MCL), joining Pearsall and Alfred Collins on the long-term list.

items.title: Brock Purdy's Strong Week 1 Fuels NFL QB Ranking Debate
items.one_line: Purdy threw for 205 yards and three TDs in a 27-7 win over the Rams in Melbourne; advanced stats since 2023 rank him first in EPA per dropback among QBs.

items.title: 49ers Voice Greg Papa Hospitalized Again with Heart Failure
items.one_line: Papa was hospitalized Sept. 7 with worsening genetic cardiomyopathy after a March bone marrow transplant; cancer-free but sidelined from the Dolphins home opener.

items.title: Baker Mayfield Faces Old Browns Team in Tampa Bay Rematch
items.one_line: Buccaneers host Cleveland in Week 2; Mayfield faces his former OC Todd Monken, who revealed Mayfield nearly joined Baltimore as Lamar's backup in 2023.

items.title: Baker Mayfield Pays Bet to Coach Bowles with Michigan Tank Top
items.one_line: After Michigan beat Oklahoma, Mayfield wore a snug Wolverines tank while Bowles sang the fight song—Bowles' son Troy starred for Michigan with nine tackles.

items.title: Titans Fall to Jets in Opener, Cam Ward Faces Early Scrutiny
items.one_line: Ward went 19-of-32 for 140 yards and a TD in a 23-10 loss; debate centers on patience with Daboll's scheme vs. PFF bad-throw volume as Saleh voiced frustration.

items.title: Titans' Simmons Calls Out Hurts: Force Him to Pass
items.one_line: Jeffery Simmons said Tennessee must stop Hurts' runs and force pocket throws ahead of Sunday in Nashville; Eagles fans pointed to Hurts' past 380-yard game vs. TEN.

items.title: Commanders Unveil RFK Stadium Site Renderings for 2030 Home
items.one_line: $3.8B project on the old RFK site features a unified bowl, transparent roof, and 65–70k capacity; construction starts next spring after 34 years away from D.C.

items.title: Commanders Place Magee on IR, Sign Patrick Amid Injuries
items.one_line: LB Jordan Magee (hamstring) to IR; OG/C Lucas Patrick signed to the 53, with Marvin Jones Jr. and Austin Keys added to the practice squad ahead of Dallas.

items.title: Commanders and Cowboys Release Injury Reports Before NFC East Clash
items.one_line: Washington DNPs: Frankie Luvu (groin), Chig Okonkwo (hamstring); six others limited including Dorance Armstrong (knee) and Charles Omenihu (ankle).
